title: AniH's Optimizations
description: A Modpack that maximizes on performance while not sacrificing quality
body:
## An Optimization Modpack

While **maximizing** performance, this modpack maintains if not **increases** the **quality** of the game. All of these mods were specifically handpicked and tested to ensure the best performance for both low-end hardware users and users who simply want to play at the highest frames they can while keeping their eyes attracted to the game.
